projection.basis: Both exhibition floor diagrams were visually inspected as plan views. Offset grey print shadows are excluded, not used as geometry or as a projection axis.

transform: translation only, equal x/y units; floor stacking is display-only
review: PDF p2 visually checked: orthographic exhibit floors. Grey south-east offset paths are printed shadows, excluded. A11 and A12 share one printed area, separate labels retained. D22 has two printed anchors; neither is deduplicated. U+F47E is the font's digit 1. Source room partitions are open-ended wall strokes; do not close the gaps or infer a room polygon by proximity.
